title: Extra client-side call being made when navigating to Algolia page (Next 13, pages dir)
body: ### 🐛 Current behavior When using the [boilerplate code](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/tree/master/examples/react/next), navigating from a simple page to a page using InstantSearch, unwanted Algolia requests appear in the network tab in the browser: **In my older projects where I'm using NextJS 12, this issue does not occur. The page simply loads without a client-side call to algolia.** ### 🔍 Steps to reproduce 1. From the homepage, click on the "Go to algolia page" link 2. Notice how a new Algolia request appears in the network tab, as soon as the Algolia page loads ### Live reproduction https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/focused-hoover-z58yzs?file=%2Fpages%2Fsearch.tsx%3A21%2C10-21%2C15 ### 💭 Expected behavior No client-side algolia call when switching between pages. ### Package version instantsearch 7.1.0, next 13.5.1 ### Operating system _No response_ ### Browser _No response_ ### Code of Conduct - [x] I agree to follow this project's Code of Conduct

comments.body: This should be fixed in https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/pull/5854 I believe, can you try that out?
